_comment: Example recipe (built-in, read-only) of the short-tube profile of stations/example_tube_line.json: is a tube on its seat, and is it this profile's tube? `presence` answers the line's part-present sensor (anything 10 mm above the seat plane is a part); `profile_height` then holds its end face to 40 +- 2 mm, so the other profile's tube is there but FAILs. Mock: scene:tube_short (present), scene:tube_short:absent.
name: tube_short_presence
description: Short tube (38 mm) on its seat: present, and this profile's
